sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: 'Quality Checks'!A17:D17 and 'Internal Quality Checks'!A17:D17 (row 16, 'C - environment/ (assets & agent image)', environment_does_not_leak_the_answer); no cell comments/drawing notes on that row
.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/task/tests/** (all judge.toml, prompt.md, app_context.md, scoring.toml) for verbatim-overlap comparison
evidence: (1) Agent image contents: task/environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and instructions/{conversations,integration,walls-and-retention}.md, so the build context cannot reach solution/ or tests/. task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty); lines 14-15 are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/' only; lines 17-23 create /app, git init, touch and commit only /app/.gitkeep. No COPY of solution/tests, no npm install of an app package, no starter server.js, schema, route list or UI. Global installs are only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (runtime deps, not the deliverable). (2) /assets/seed_data.json (sha256 f69616e2...be36, matches raw-evidence-index entry and is byte-identical to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json, as the brief requires the agent to copy it) holds only inputs: clock, accounts, timer options, matters with raw messages (id, author, at, parent, body, hold, versions), walls and read_up_to. It contains no derived outcomes: no deleted/expired flags, no precomputed transcripts, unread counts, search results or DB schema; which messages a timer removes (e.g. K-1 at 11 days on a 7-day matter) must be computed by the app. (3) /instructions notes are product requirements in client voice. A grep for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe over environment/ and instruction.md returns no hits. A 10-token n-gram overlap scan of instruction.md + all three notes against every tests/**/*.toml and *.md file finds zero overlap with any judge.toml/prompt.md (0 for constraints, render, functional (3912 tokens), polish, visual); the only overlap is 3 n-grams in tests/app_context.md from the account table (emails/names/roles), which are public inputs, not criterion text. Notes describe what to build, not how it will be checked; they do not name API routes, schema or criterion ids. (4) Weak/alternative probes: a broken app cannot pass by copying something from the image because no finished or partial deliverable exists there; a conforming alternative cannot fail because of this row since nothing in the environment imposes a hidden structure. Not exercised: I did not docker build and list /app in a live agent image (static Dockerfile is the unchanged template and deterministic, so this is not a required missing measurement for this row).
